how: Extract the download. Leave the extracted folder and its files as they are, in a folder whose path has no spaces or double-byte characters.

how: With PTZOptics' Upgrade Tool: v2.8 on Windows; the Mac tool, v2.7, cannot back up or restore, and on Big Sur cannot search, so type the address in.
Some G2 cameras update over the network, some over USB, some both: the instructions list which.
warnings: Use firmware for the right camera type: an SoC version starting with 6 is PoE, with 7 non-PoE. PTZOptics warns the wrong firmware may permanently damage the camera.
There are two Upgrade Tool v2.8C builds, Old MAC (D4:E0:8E…) and New MAC (DC:ED:84…). The wrong one changes the camera's MAC address.
A backup holds that camera's MAC address, serial number and focus data: never restore it to another camera.
The camera may need a focus calibration afterwards. A file saved twice as "… (1)" must be renamed before it will load.
